title: Westamerica Bancorp's Dividend Analysis
summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus. Westamerica Bancorp (NASDAQ:WABC) recently announced a total dividend of $0.48 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-08-03. This includes a $0.48 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-08-14.

title: Westamerica Bancorporation Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
summary: SAN RAFAEL, Calif., July 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Board of Directors of Westamerica Bancorporation (NASDAQ: WABC) today declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.48 per share on common stock outstanding to shareholders of record at the close of business August 3, 2026. The dividend is payable August 14, 2026.
